nodes.text: Find some reasonable function $f(n)$ such that, for almost all integers $n$, the least integer $m$ such that $m\nmid \binom{2n}{n}$ satisfies\[m\sim f(n).\]

#731 : [EGRS75] number theory | binomial coefficients A problem of Erdős, Graham, Ruzsa, and Straus [EGRS75] , who say it is 'not hard to show that', for almost all $n$, the minimal such $m$ satisfies\[m=\exp((\log n)^{1/2+o(1)}).\] Proof expositions (0) If you would like to contribute an exposition of a proof related to this problem, please message a moderator or leave your exposition as a comment.
